    25→/// at the Scribe boundary so all internal lookups use consistent bare names.
    26→pub fn normalize_layer_name(name: &str, page_id: &str) -> String {
    27→    let prefix = format!("{}/", page_id);
    28→    if let Some(bare) = name.strip_prefix(&prefix) {
    29→        bare.to_string()

    43→/// Shorten a layer name by collapsing `did:key:...` segments to `...`

    48→                "..."

    57→fn decode_permit_summary(token: &str, event_layer_name: &str) -> serde_json::Value {

   319→impl ScribeState {
   320→    /// Protocol-reserved sync metadata layer name.
   321→    ///
   322→    /// These layers are pairwise and handled by protocol rules, not permit templates.
   323→    fn is_protocol_sync_meta_layer(layer_name: &str) -> bool {
   324→        layer_name.starts_with("__sync_meta/")
   325→    }
   326→
   327→    /// Get the next capture sequence number (monotonically increasing)
   328→    fn next_capture_seq(&self) -> u64 {
   329→        self.capture_seq.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
   330→    }
   331→
   332→    /// Check if a layer should sync based on permit configuration
   333→    ///
   334→    /// **Context**: Used to filter out local-only layers (sync: false) before broadcasting
   335→    /// **Returns**: true if layer should sync, false if local-only
   336→    pub fn should_sync_layer(&self, layer_name: &str) -> bool {
   337→        if Self::is_protocol_sync_meta_layer(layer_name) {
   338→            return true;
   339→        }
   340→
   341→        self.our_permit
   342→            .as_ref()
   343→            .map(|permit| permit.should_sync_layer(layer_name, &self.page_id, &self.our_did))
   344→            .unwrap_or(true) // No permit means sync everything
   345→    }
   346→
   347→    /// Track a newly created sync-enabled layer in our protocol sync metadata map.
   348→    ///
   349→    /// **Context**: Local layer creation (dynamic layer or first-write implicit layer).
   350→    /// **We store**: `__sync_meta/<our_did>[<layer_name>] = {synced: false, version: 1}`.
   351→    /// **Why**: Keep pairwise sync metadata current so node receives layer bootstrap state.
   352→    pub fn track_new_sync_layer_in_meta(&mut self, layer_name: &str) {
   353→        if !self.should_sync_layer(layer_name) || Self::is_protocol_sync_meta_layer(layer_name) {
   354→            return;
   355→        }
   356→
   357→        let sync_meta_layer = format!("__sync_meta/{}", self.our_did);
   358→        let created_sync_meta_layer = if !self.units.contains_key(&sync_meta_layer) {
   359→            let mut unit = LayerUnit::new_empty();
   360→            unit.set_local_only(false);
   361→            self.units.insert(sync_meta_layer.clone(), unit);
   362→            true
   363→        } else {
   364→            false
   365→        };
   366→
   367→        if let Some(unit) = self.units.get_mut(&sync_meta_layer) {
   368→            let map = unit.layer().loro().get_map(sync_meta_layer.as_str());
   369→            if map
   370→                .insert(
   371→                    layer_name,
   372→                    json_to_loro_value(&serde_json::json!({"synced": false, "version": 1})),
   373→                )
   374→                .is_ok()
   375→            {
   376→                unit.layer().commit();
   377→                unit.mark_dirty();
   378→            }
   379→        }
   380→
   381→        if created_sync_meta_layer {
   382→            crate::loro_observer::setup_layer_observer(self, &sync_meta_layer);
   383→        }
   384→    }

   394→    /// Emit a sync event to the capture channel (pre-serialized JSON line)
   395→    ///
   396→    /// **Context**: Called before sync_event_tx.send() to capture SyncEvent for observability
   397→    pub fn emit_sync_event_capture(&self, event: &SyncEvent) {
   398→        if let Some(ref tx) = self.capture_tx {
   399→            let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
   400→                .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
   401→                .map(|d| d.as_millis())
   402→                .unwrap_or(0);
   403→            if let Ok(json) = serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
   404→                "type": "sync_event",
   405→                "ts": ts,
   406→                "seq": self.next_capture_seq(),
   407→                "page_id": &self.page_id,
   408→                "data": event,
   409→            })) {
   410→                let _ = tx.send(json);
   411→            }
   412→
   413→            match event {
   414→                SyncEvent::NewDynamicLayer {
   415→                    page_id,
   416→                    layer_name,
   417→                    permits,
   418→                }
   419→                | SyncEvent::LayerAccessChanged {
   420→                    page_id,
   421→                    layer_name,
   422→                    permits,
   423→                } => {
   424→                    let source = match event {
   425→                        SyncEvent::NewDynamicLayer { .. } => "new_dynamic_layer",
   426→                        SyncEvent::LayerAccessChanged { .. } => "layer_access_changed",
   427→                        SyncEvent::EnsureSync { .. } => "ensure_sync",
   428→                    };
   429→
   430→                    for (audience_did, token) in permits {
   431→                        let permit_summary = decode_permit_summary(token, layer_name);
   432→                        if let Ok(json) = serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
   433→                            "type": "permit_generated",
   434→                            "ts": ts,
   435→                            "seq": self.next_capture_seq(),
   436→                            "page_id": page_id,
   437→                            "layer": layer_name,
   438→                            "layer_short": layer_short(layer_name),
   439→                            "audience": audience_did,
   440→                            "short_did": short_did(audience_did),
   441→                            "source": source,
   442→                            "permit": permit_summary,
   443→                        })) {
   444→                            let _ = tx.send(json);
   445→                        }
   446→                    }
   447→                }
   448→                SyncEvent::EnsureSync { .. } => {}
   449→            }
   450→        }
   451→    }

    16→/// Payload sent to PeerActor for broadcast (3-step sync protocol)

    51→pub struct EphemeralOutbound {

    58→/// Delta operations for different Loro container types
    59→///
    60→/// **Context**: Represents incremental changes to CRDT containers
    61→/// **Usage**: Lua apps can apply deltas for efficient UI updates (preserve scroll, animations)
    62→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    63→#[serde(tag = "type")]
    64→pub enum LoroDelta {
    65→    /// List delta: sequence of Retain/Insert/Delete operations
    66→    List { ops: Vec<ListOp> },
    67→
    68→    /// Map delta: updated keys

    70→        updated: HashMap<String, Option<serde_json::Value>>,

## Current State: Sync Meta + Custom Channels + Layer Discovery

### The Flow (as implemented)

```
Owner creates dynamic layer
  → track_new_sync_layer_in_meta() writes __sync_meta/{our_did}[layer] = {synced: false, version: 1}
  → Loro observer triggers → SyncOffer sent to node
  → Node receives SyncOffer
    ├── If authority_permit bundled:
    │     store_layer_authority_permit()
    │     fanout_sync_meta_from_authority() → writes __sync_meta/{recipient}[layer] = {synced: false}
    ├── ApplyUpdate on data layer → emit_dynamic_layer_permits() → SyncEvent::NewDynamicLayer
    └── If __sync_meta layer updated:
          request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta() → SyncReset for missing layers

Viewer receives SyncOffer for __sync_meta/{viewer_did}
  → Updates trigger request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta()
  → Viewer sends SyncReset for layers it doesn't have
  → Node responds with SyncSnapshot
  → Viewer marks __sync_meta/{viewer_did}[layer] = {synced: true}
```

### Integration Tests: What's confirmed vs what's next

**Confirmed working (tests pass):**
1. `test_owner_layer_sync_to_node` — static layer owner→node
2. `test_owner_chat_layer_sync_to_node` — list layer owner→node
3. `diagnostic_owner_page_bootstrap_creates_sync_meta_layer` — sync-meta created + synced to node
4. `diagnostic_viewer_add_website_bootstrap_sync_meta_to_node` — viewer bootstrap sync-meta
5. `test_viewer_receives_page` — viewer gets page metadata
6. `test_owner_to_viewer_layer_flow` — full chain owner→node→viewer (static)
7. `test_static_channel_layer_syncs_to_node` — static channel to node
8. `test_static_channel_layer_syncs_to_viewer` — static channel full chain
9. `test_dynamic_layer_syncs_to_viewer` — dynamic layer via `CreateDynamicLayer` to viewer (**role-granted channels**)
10. `test_dynamic_layer_create_layer_syncs_to_node` — dynamic layer to node
11. `test_node_requests_missing_layer_from_sync_meta_update` — node sends SyncReset after sync-meta
12. `test_node_fanout_sync_meta_from_layer_authority` — node writes recipient sync-meta
13. `test_required_viewer_receives_new_dynamic_layer_after_subscribe` — viewer materializes + marks synced=true

**Explicit/DM layer tests (the hard part):**
14. `test_custom_channel_data_syncs_to_viewer` — channels_meta static OK, dynamic channel message data needed
15. `test_offline_viewer_gets_layer_on_subscribe_via_authority_permit` — offline viewer + authority permit flow
16. `test_add_layer_access_issues_permit_from_authority` — AddLayerAccess via authority
17. `test_creator_add_layer_access_issues_local_permit` — creator-side local permit
18. `diagnostic_custom_layer_multiple_dids_issue_permits_from_authority_facts` — multi-DID authority facts
19. `test_dm_owner_created_layer_visible_to_online_participant` — **current bug**: DM layer doesn't reach viewer
20. `test_dm_offline_participant_receives_layer_on_subscribe` — **current bug**: offline DM
21. `diagnostic_dm_explicit_layer_requires_access_grant_for_online_participant` — confirms gap: explicit layers need access grant
22. `diagnostic_dm_offline_subscriber_without_authority_does_not_receive_layer` — confirms gap
23. `diagnostic_dm_same_logical_id_creates_distinct_creator_namespaced_layers` — confirms DID namespacing

### What needs to happen next for "other peers also getting it"

The core gap is: **viewer's sync-meta update triggers `request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta()` which sends SyncReset — but this only works if the viewer's sync-meta layer actually gets updated with the new layer entry.** The chain is:

1. Node `fanout_sync_meta_from_authority()` writes `__sync_meta/{viewer_did}[layer] = {synced:false}` — **confirmed working** (test 12)
2. This sync-meta layer change must reach the viewer via broadcast — depends on the viewer being **authorized** for `__sync_meta/{viewer_did}` on the node's Scribe
3. Viewer receives it, processes it in `request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta()`, sends SyncReset

The authorization logic in `authorize_subscriber_for_layers()` (subscription.rs:174-181) handles this:
```rust
if layer_name.starts_with("__sync_meta/") {
    let did_in_layer = layer_name.trim_start_matches("__sync_meta/");
    if user_did == did_in_layer || sync_target == Some(user_did) {
        unit.authorize_did(user_did);
    }
}
```
This means: viewer is only authorized for their **own** `__sync_meta/{viewer_did}` — correct.

---

## Critical Code Quality Issues

### 1. Capture System Bloat (~300 lines of near-identical methods)

`scribe/src/state.rs` has **8 `emit_*_capture()` methods** that are copy-paste with minor field differences:
- `emit_sync_event_capture` (lines 397-451)
- `emit_layer_auth_capture` (lines 456-476)
- `emit_permission_check_capture` (lines 481-509)
- `emit_apply_update_capture` (lines 514-541)
- `emit_page_update_capture` (lines 546-562)
- `emit_subscriber_state_capture` (lines 567-598)
- `emit_broadcast_decision_capture` (lines 603-624)

Every single one does: `SystemTime::now()` → `duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)` → `next_capture_seq()` → `serde_json::to_string(&json!({...}))` → `tx.send()`. This should be a single `emit_capture(&self, event_type: &str, data: serde_json::Value)` helper.

### 2. `decode_permit_summary` is debug-only code in production path

`state.rs:57-96` — This function parses permits and extracts fields purely for capture JSON. It's called inside `emit_sync_event_capture` which runs on every sync event. Permit parsing is not cheap.

### 3. `SubscriberInfo::can_receive_layer` is dead code

`state.rs:168-185` — This method exists but is **no longer called anywhere**. The broadcast path now uses `unit.authorized_dids()` directly. Should be removed.

### 4. `Permissions::is_local_only` is hardcoded

`permit.rs:166-171`:
```rust
pub fn is_local_only(layer_name: &str) -> bool {
    layer_name == "user_content_doc"
}
```
This hardcodes a single layer name. The actual local-only information comes from the permit's `sync_facts.local_only` list and is properly handled via `LayerUnit.set_local_only()`. This static method is misleading and should be removed or unified.

### 5. Duplicate `authority_layer_config` functions

There are **two** `authority_layer_config` functions doing the same thing:
- `scribe/src/sync/subscription.rs:382-399` — module-private
- `scribe/src/layer_unit/dynamic.rs:498-519` — named `authority_layer_config_and_intent`

Both parse authority tokens and extract LayerConfig. The one in `dynamic.rs` additionally returns the intent CID. Should be consolidated.

### 6. Duplicate `find_matching_dynamic_schema` logic

`courier/src/peer_actor/sync/protocol.rs:34-75` (`authority_schema_for_layer`) is a near-identical copy of `scribe/src/layer_unit/dynamic.rs:282-338` (`find_matching_dynamic_schema`). Both do segment-by-segment schema matching. The courier version returns `&DynamicLayerSchema`, scribe's returns `(&str, &DynamicLayerSchema, String)`. Should share a common function.

### 7. `_device_id` parameter in `issue_pending_layer_permits`

`subscription.rs:321` — parameter `_device_id: &str` is unused (prefixed with `_`). Either use it or remove it.

### 8. `handle_remove_layer_access` is a stub

`dynamic.rs:483-496` — Returns `Err("RemoveLayerAccess is deprecated...")` unconditionally. The `let _ = layer_name; let _ = did;` pattern is particularly bad — it suppresses unused warnings for parameters that could just be prefixed with `_`.

### 9. `emit_dynamic_layer_permits` has dead code block

`apply.rs:488-492`:
```rust
if let Some(unit) = state.units.get(layer_name) {
    let _ = unit;  // Note: is_dynamic is pub so we'd need get_mut...
}
```
This block does nothing. Remove it.

### 10. `RecordingPermitIssuer` test fixture partially unused

`dynamic.rs:537-585` — The `issued` field records `(String, String, LayerConfig)` tuples but `issue_layer_permit` doesn't record anything (returns hardcoded values). Only `issue_layer_authority_permit` records. Inconsistent.

---

## Stale Artifacts to Clean Up

| File | Status |
|------|--------|
| `.entire/` directory | Tool artifact, add to `.gitignore` or delete |
| `test_presence.py` (repo root) | Debug script, move to `scripts/` or delete |
| `query_presence.py` (repo root) | Debug script, move to `scripts/` or delete |
| `scripts/test_remote_connect.py` | Untracked, evaluate if needed |
| `docs/OBSERVABILITY.md` | Untracked new file |
| `docs/QUALITY_ANALYSIS.md` | Untracked new file |

---

## Architectural Observations

### Good decisions in this diff:
- **LayerUnit abstraction** — consolidating per-layer state (LoroDoc, dirty, local_only, observer, authorized_dids) into a single struct is clean
- **Authorization at subscribe time** — populating `authorized_dids` upfront rather than checking permits on every broadcast is a performance win
- **Sync-meta as pairwise CRDT layers** — using Loro maps for sync metadata means the protocol gets CRDT conflict resolution for free
- **Authority permit bundling on SyncOffer** — piggybacking authority permits on data sync messages avoids extra round trips

### Concerning patterns:
- **The capture system is observability debt** — ~300 lines of capture code in state.rs makes the core state struct harder to maintain. Consider a separate `CaptureEmitter` struct
- **`futures::executor::block_on()` in `ButlerPermitIssuer`** — known issue, still present, blocks the tokio runtime
- **Sync-meta layer proliferation** — each peer gets their own `__sync_meta/{did}` layer, and the node holds all of them. With N peers, the node has N sync-meta layers plus all data layers. No eviction strategy.

### Summary of what's needed to complete the feature:

The sync-meta fanout is working (test 12 confirms). The gap is in the **viewer receiving and processing** the updated sync-meta. The flow `fanout_sync_meta → broadcast to viewer → viewer SyncReset → node SyncSnapshot` should work if:

1. The viewer is authorized for their `__sync_meta/{viewer_did}` layer on the node (it is, per subscription.rs logic)
2. The node's Scribe broadcasts the sync-meta update to the viewer (it should, via Loro observer → broadcast_update)
3. The viewer's PeerActor processes the incoming sync-meta update and calls `request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta` (it does, per protocol.rs:388-391)

If tests 19-20 (DM layer visibility) are failing, the issue is likely in the **explicit grant** flow — DMs use `GrantType::Explicit` which requires `AddLayerAccess` to issue permits, unlike channels which use `GrantType::Role` and auto-issue to all matching roles. The diagnostic tests (21-23) confirm this is by design — explicit layers require the creator to call `add_layer_access()` for each participant.

# Comprehensive Diff Analysis: `feature/coordinator-refactor` Branch

## 1. GURKHA (Permit Parse + Validate)

### What Changed

**Major conceptual shift**: `layer_patterns` (regex-like glob patterns for matching dynamic layers at check time) have been replaced with `dynamic_layer_schemas` (structured schema definitions with grant type and role-based permissions). This is a cleaner model -- patterns were brittle and required per-check expansion, whereas schemas carry all the information needed for permit issuance.

Key additions in `/home/abe/osvauld/gurkha/src/parser/mod.rs`:
- `DynamicLayerSchema` struct with `layer_type`, `grant: GrantType`, `permissions: Option<LayerConfig>`, `role_permissions: HashMap<String, LayerConfig>`
- `GrantType` enum: `Role` (shared channels, role-gated) vs `Explicit` (private/DMs, authority-driven)
- `resolve_page_id_in_facts()` -- resolves `{page_id}` placeholders in layer keys at permit signing time rather than check time
- `matches_schema_pattern()` for validating layer paths against schemas
- `PeerCapabilities` gains `manage_layer_access: bool`
- `Permit` gains `dynamic_layer_schemas()` accessor

Key additions in `/home/abe/osvauld/gurkha/src/decision/layer.rs`:
- Complete rewrite. Old `expand_pattern_with_iss()` and `matches_layer_pattern()` removed.
- New `can_access_with_layer_permits()` -- two-tier check (page permit then layer permits)
- `matches_dynamic_schema_for_role()`, `matches_creator_schema()`, `matches_dynamic_path()`, `matches_dynamic_path_any_did()`
- `check_operation()` helper for permission checks

Key additions in `/home/abe/osvauld/gurkha/src/service.rs`:
- `issue_layer_permit()` -- node issues layer-scoped permit to viewer
- `issue_layer_authority_permit()` -- creator issues authority to node for a specific layer
- `reissue_permit_with_layers()` -- merges new dynamic layers into an existing page permit
- `issue_sync_layer_consent()` -- viewer issues consent to node for layer sync

Key additions in `/home/abe/osvauld/gurkha/src/decision/consent.rs`:
- `decide_sync_layer_consent()` for layer-level consent verification

### Issues Found

1. **`_our_did` parameter now unused**: In `should_sync_layer()` (line 1041) and `static_layers()` (line 1109) of `/home/abe/osvauld/gurkha/src/parser/mod.rs`, the `_our_did` parameter is prefixed with underscore, meaning it is no longer used. The old pattern-matching code needed it for DID expansion. The callers still pass it. This parameter should be removed from the API rather than silently suppressed.

2. **All proptest tests removed**: `/home/abe/osvauld/gurkha/src/decision/sync.rs` and `/home/abe/osvauld/gurkha/src/decision/layer.rs` have lost all property-based tests. They are replaced with fixture-based tests, which is fine for correctness but loses the fuzzing coverage that proptest provided. This is a tradeoff worth noting.

3. **`decide_sync_layer_consent()` TODO**: In `/home/abe/osvauld/gurkha/src/decision/sync.rs` line 89: `// TODO: Implement simple permit-based logic in Phase 4`. This function currently always returns `Ok(())` -- it is a no-op stub that passes everything through.

4. **`resolve_page_id_in_facts()` duplicated across crate boundary**: This function exists in gurkha's parser but is also called from `gurkha/src/test_fixtures.rs` with a new `resolve_aud_in_layers()` helper. The test fixture layer resolution logic feels like it could drift from the real code.

---

## 2. BUTLER (Storage + Services)

### What Changed

**New storage tables**: Four new tables in `/home/abe/osvauld/butler/src/storage/store/mod.rs`:
- `LAYER_PERMITS` -- per-page, per-audience, per-layer permit tokens
- `DYNAMIC_LAYER_META` -- metadata about dynamic layers (creator, schema, timestamp)
- `VIEWER_LAYER_CONSENTS` -- viewer-issued consent for layer sync
- `LAYER_AUTHORITY_PERMITS` -- creator-to-node authority permits for explicit grant layers

**New file**: `/home/abe/osvauld/butler/src/storage/store/dynamic_layer.rs` -- CRUD for all four tables.

**`ButlerPermitIssuer`** in `/home/abe/osvauld/butler/src/scribe_storage.rs` (lines 19-123):
- Implements `scribe::PermitIssuer` trait
- Holds signing key, node permit token, page ID, store reference
- Uses `futures::executor::block_on()` in two methods (lines 52, 104)

**`capture_tx` plumbing** in `/home/abe/osvauld/butler/src/lib.rs`:
- `RwLock<Option<broadcast::Sender<String>>>` on Butler
- `set_capture_tx()` method
- `build_scribe_args()` creates `ButlerPermitIssuer` and passes `capture_tx`

**Page service changes** in `/home/abe/osvauld/butler/src/services/page_service.rs`:
- `create_page()` now creates `__sync_meta/{owner_did}` layer with bootstrap entries
- Owner permit issuance moved earlier in the flow

**Publish filter** in `/home/abe/osvauld/butler/src/services/publish_service.rs`:
- Filters `__sync_meta/` layers during publish (they are pairwise, not for viewers)

### Issues Found

1. **`futures::executor::block_on()` in async context** (KNOWN, from MEMORY.md): `/home/abe/osvauld/butler/src/scribe_storage.rs` lines 52 and 104. This is called from within `PermitIssuer` trait methods which are sync (`fn` not `async fn`), but the callers run inside tokio tasks. `block_on` inside a tokio runtime will panic if called on a tokio thread that hasn't entered the runtime. This works in practice because the PermitIssuer is called from ractor actor `handle` methods which run on the tokio runtime's blocking pool, but it's fragile. The same pattern appears at lines 260, 264 of the same file.

2. **`_layer_cache` parameter is dead code**: In `/home/abe/osvauld/butler/src/lib.rs` lines 103 and 122, the `_layer_cache: Arc<RwLock<LayerCache>>` parameter is stored but never used. The underscore prefix hides the warning. This parameter should either be removed or put to use.

3. **New `PermitsApi` methods lack `#[instrument]`**: The new methods in `/home/abe/osvauld/butler/src/api/permits.rs` (`list_page_permits`, `reissue_all_page_permits`, `store_layer_permit`, `get_layer_permits`, etc.) do not have `#[instrument]` annotations, violating the CLAUDE.md policy. This is consistent with the pre-existing issue noted in MEMORY.md -- Butler has zero `#[instrument]` annotations broadly.

4. **`store_layer_authority_permit()` compound key construction**: The storage code creates compound keys by concatenating `{page_id}:{layer_name}:{audience}`. If any of these values contain `:`, the key becomes ambiguous and could collide. Layer names with DIDs (like `channels/did:key:alice/general/messages`) contain colons. This is a real bug -- keys like `page1:channels/did:key:alice/general:did:key:bob` are ambiguous.

---

## 3. COURIER (P2P Orchestration)

### What Changed

**New wire protocol messages** in `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/message.rs`:
- `LayerPermitMsg` (tag `0x0205`) -- node sends layer permit to viewer
- `LayerConsentGrantMsg` (tag `0x0502`) -- viewer sends consent back to node
- `LayerConsentAckMsg` (tag `0x0503`) -- node acks consent
- `SyncOfferMsg` gains `authority_permit: Option<String>` field for piggybacking

**Coordinator** in `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/coordinator/mod.rs`:
- New `CoordinatorMessage` variants: `DistributeLayerPermits`, `DistributePagePermitUpdates`
- `capture_tx` threaded through for observability

**PeerActor consent flow** in `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/peer_actor/consent.rs`:
- `send_layer_permit()` -- node sends LayerPermitMsg to viewer
- `on_layer_permit()` -- viewer receives, stores, authorizes on Scribe, auto-issues consent
- `issue_layer_consent()` -- viewer creates consent permit and sends
- `on_layer_consent_grant()` -- node receives consent, stores, acks
- `on_layer_consent_ack()` -- viewer receives ack (currently just logs)

**Sync meta bootstrap** in `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/peer_actor/publish.rs`:
- `bootstrap_and_send_sync_meta_for_page()` (~160 lines) -- viewer creates sync-meta layer with entries for all sync-enabled layers, sends as SyncOffer

**Protocol extensions** in `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/peer_actor/sync/protocol.rs`:
- `fanout_sync_meta_from_authority()` -- node writes sync-meta entries for recipients
- `request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta()` -- peer reads sync-meta, sends SyncReset for missing layers

## 7. OVERALL FEATURE FLOW: Sync Meta / Custom Channels / Layer Discovery

The feature implements a three-tier dynamic layer system on top of the existing static layer model. Here is the end-to-end flow:

### Layer Creation (Viewer Side)
1. Lua app calls `scribe:create_layer("channels/{id}/messages", "general")` 
2. Scribe's `handle_create_dynamic_layer()` validates the schema key exists in the permit's `dynamic_layer_schemas`
3. Generates full path: `channels/{creator_did}/{layer_id}/messages`
4. Creates `LayerUnit` with `is_dynamic = true`
5. Writes entry to `__sync_meta/{our_did}` layer (tracking what we sync)
6. Issues creator layer authority permits to all current subscribers (step 5 in dynamic.rs line 71)
7. Layer syncs to node via normal SyncOffer/SyncAccept/SyncAck

### Layer Detection (Node Side)
1. Node receives layer data via sync protocol
2. `create_layer_from_peer()` in `sync/apply.rs` calls `find_matching_dynamic_schema()` to check if the new layer matches a dynamic schema
3. If matched, `emit_dynamic_layer_permits()` calls `prepare_layer_permits()` to determine recipients
4. For `GrantType::Role`: all peers with matching roles get layer permits
5. For `GrantType::Explicit`: only peers with authority permits get layer permits
6. Permits emitted as `SyncEvent::NewDynamicLayer` to Coordinator

### Permit Distribution (Coordinator)
1. Coordinator receives `DistributeLayerPermits` message
2. Stores permits in Butler (`store_layer_permit`)
3. Sends `SendLayerPermit` to each target PeerActor
4. PeerActor sends `LayerPermitMsg` over the wire

### Permit Receipt (Viewer Side)
1. Viewer receives `LayerPermitMsg`
2. `on_layer_permit()` stores permit in Butler, authorizes DID on local Scribe
3. Auto-issues layer consent back to node (`issue_layer_consent()`)
4. Node receives consent, stores, sends ack

### Sync Meta Protocol
1. Owner creates page -> `page_service.rs` creates `__sync_meta/{owner_did}` with bootstrap entries for all sync-enabled layers
2. Viewer joins -> `bootstrap_and_send_sync_meta_for_page()` creates `__sync_meta/{viewer_did}` and sends as SyncOffer
3. Node processes sync-meta -> `fanout_sync_meta_from_authority()` writes sync-meta entries for other recipients
4. Viewer reads sync-meta -> `request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta()` sends SyncReset for layers it doesn't have

### Authority Permit Piggybacking
1. When building SyncOffer for explicit layers, `subscription.rs` looks up `get_layer_authority_permit()`
2. Authority permit token is added to `SyncOfferMsg.authority_permit`
3. Node processes bundled authority via `on_sync_offer()` -> `authority_schema_for_layer()`

## 8. STRUCTURAL CONCERNS (Cross-Cutting)

1. **Capture system adds ~300 lines of observability boilerplate to Scribe alone**, plus plumbing in Butler, Courier, and both entry points (kunki, sthalam). This is concentrated in `butler/src/scribe_storage.rs` (4x) and `lua_runtime/src/scribe_handle.rs` (3x) plus `butler/src/services/app_service.rs` (1x). Each call site risks a panic if the tokio runtime context changes. The `PermitIssuer` trait should have async methods, with synchronous wrappers only at the boundary.

2. Scribe's `handle_create_dynamic_layer()` validates the schema key exists in the permit's `dynamic_layer_schemas`
3. Generates full path: `channels/{creator_did}/{layer_id}/messages`

5. Writes entry to `__sync_meta/{our_did}` layer (tracking what we sync)
6. Issues creator layer authority permits to all current subscribers (step 5 in dynamic.rs line 71)

### Layer Detection (Node Side)
1. Node receives layer data via sync protocol
2. `create_layer_from_peer()` in `sync/apply.rs` calls `find_matching_dynamic_schema()` to check if the new layer matches a dynamic schema
3. If matched, `emit_dynamic_layer_permits()` calls `prepare_layer_permits()` to determine recipients

5. For `GrantType::Explicit`: only peers with authority permits get layer permits

2. Stores permits in Butler (`store_layer_permit`)
3. Sends `SendLayerPermit` to each target PeerActor
4. PeerActor sends `LayerPermitMsg` over the wire

1. Viewer receives `LayerPermitMsg`
2. `on_layer_permit()` stores permit in Butler, authorizes DID on local Scribe
3. Auto-issues layer consent back to node (`issue_layer_consent()`)

2. Viewer joins -> `bootstrap_and_send_sync_meta_for_page()` creates `__sync_meta/{viewer_did}` and sends as SyncOffer
3. Node processes sync-meta -> `fanout_sync_meta_from_authority()` writes sync-meta entries for other recipients
4. Viewer reads sync-meta -> `request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta()` sends SyncReset for layers it doesn't have

1. When building SyncOffer for explicit layers, `subscription.rs` looks up `get_layer_authority_permit()`
2. Authority permit token is added to `SyncOfferMsg.authority_permit`
3. Node processes bundled authority via `on_sync_offer()` -> `authority_schema_for_layer()`

A macro or trait-based approach would reduce this.

2. **Two different "can receive" checks coexist**: `SubscriberInfo::can_receive_layer()` (page-permit-based, used at subscribe time for initial authorization) and `LayerUnit.authorized_dids` (runtime-maintained, used for broadcast filtering). The migration is incomplete -- `can_receive_layer` populates `authorized_dids`, which then becomes the source of truth. This two-source-of-truth approach could lead to inconsistencies if one path is updated without the other.

3. **Compound key collision risk**: Butler's storage uses `:` as a separator in compound keys, but layer names contain `did:key:` prefixes with colons. A composite key like `page1:channels/did:key:alice/gen:did:key:bob` is ambiguous -- is the audience `did:key:bob` or `key:bob`?

4. **Error handling in courier publish.rs swallows partial state**: `bootstrap_and_send_sync_meta_for_page()` does many sequential steps (EnsureLoroMap, MapInsert, GetSnapshot, GetStateVector, encrypt, send). Each step returns early on error with `warn!` + `return`, but earlier writes (like MapInsert) are not rolled back. This leaves sync-meta in a partially written state.

5. **`futures::executor::block_on` appears 8 times** across the codebase. This is concentrated in `butler/src/scribe_storage.rs` (4x) and `lua_runtime/src/scribe_handle.rs` (3x) plus `butler/src/services/app_service.rs` (1x). Each call site risks a panic if the tokio runtime context changes. The `PermitIssuer` trait should have async methods, with synchronous wrappers only at the boundary.

6. **Unbounded pending state**: Both `pending_layer_authorizations` (Scribe) and the existing `pending_*` HashMaps in PeerActor have no eviction policy. These grow indefinitely if expected events never arrive.</result>

Perfect! Now I have the full picture. Let me compile a comprehensive trace document of the dynamic layer sync flow.

## Full Dynamic Layer Sync Flow Analysis

Based on my thorough code review, here is the complete trace of how dynamic layer sync should flow, with identified gaps:

### **HIGH-LEVEL FLOW**

```
1. Owner creates dynamic layer via scribe:create_layer("channels/{id}/messages", "general")
   └─> Layer created as: channels/{owner_did}/general/messages

2. Owner writes data to layer
   └─> Observer syncs layer to node via SyncOffer (with authority_permit piggybacked)

3. Node receives SyncOffer with authority_permit
   └─> Node parses authority permit → calls fanout_sync_meta_from_authority()
       └─> Node writes __sync_meta/{viewer_did}[channels/{owner_did}/general/messages] = {synced: false}

4. Node detects new layer from peer (emit_dynamic_layer_permits)
   └─> Checks if layer matches dynamic schema
   └─> Issues layer permits for connected peers
   └─> Emits SyncEvent::NewDynamicLayer

5. Coordinator receives SyncEvent::NewDynamicLayer
   └─> Stores layer permits in butler
   └─> Sends LayerPermitMsg to each viewer's PeerActor

6. Viewer's PeerActor receives LayerPermitMsg
   └─> Stores layer permit in butler
   └─> Calls AuthorizeLayerSubscriber to authorize node on local Scribe
   └─> Issues layer consent back to node

7. Viewer's Scribe broadcasts __sync_meta/{viewer_did} update to node
   └─> Viewer sees empty layer in sync-meta → calls request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta()

8. Viewer's PeerActor sends SyncReset to node
   └─> Node responds with SyncSnapshot (full layer data)

9. Viewer applies SyncSnapshot
   └─> Layer data now available
```

---

### **DETAILED FILE-BY-FILE TRACE**

#### **1. `/home/abe/osvauld/scribe/src/layer_unit/dynamic.rs` - Layer Creation**

**Entry Point**: `handle_create_dynamic_layer()` (line 19-74)
- Validates schema exists in owner's permit
- Generates full path: `channels/{owner_did}/{layer_id}/messages`
- Creates LayerUnit and sets `is_dynamic = true`
- Calls `track_new_sync_layer_in_meta(&bare_path)` → writes `__sync_meta/{owner_did}[channels/...] = {synced: false}`
- Calls `issue_creator_layer_authority_permits()` (line 76-139)
  - Issues authority permits to all connected subscribers (node in viewer mode, or connected viewers in node mode)
  - Authority permit will be piggybacked on next SyncOffer from this layer

**Key State**: 
- Layer created with `is_dynamic = true` (line 54)
- Observer set up to broadcast changes
- Authority permits issued but **not yet sent** — only issued for later piggybacking

---

#### **2. `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/peer_actor/sync/protocol.rs` - Authority Fanout**

**Entry Point**: `on_sync_offer()` (line 262-439)

**Step 1: Authority Permit Piggybacking** (line 297-344)
```rust
if let Some(permit) = authority_permit {
    // Parse and store authority permit
    // If Node mode: fanout_sync_meta_from_authority()
}
```

**Critical Function**: `fanout_sync_meta_from_authority()` (line 77-164)
- Receives the authority permit from a SyncOffer
- **Determines recipients** (line 93-147):
  - For **explicit grants**: gets authorized_peers directly from permit
  - For **role grants**: lists all authorized users for page, filters by role matching schema.role_permissions
- **For each recipient** (line 149-163):
  - Writes to `__sync_meta/{recipient_did}[layer_name] = {synced: false, version: 1}`
  - This notifies viewer that a new dynamic layer exists

**Critical Gap #1**: The recipient determination logic requires:
1. If **role grant**: Must look up all users on the page AND their permits
2. Must match `schema.role_permissions.contains_key(role)` where role comes from peer's page permit's "role" or "relationship" fact
3. The schema object **must exist** in the authority permit's `dynamic_layer_schemas`

**Step 2: Apply Update** (line 370-392)
- Applies the CRDT update to the layer
- If it's a `__sync_meta/` layer: calls `request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta()`

---

#### **3. `/home/abe/osvauld/scribe/src/sync/apply.rs` - Dynamic Layer Detection**

**Entry Point**: `emit_dynamic_layer_permits()` (line 462-547)

**Triggered when**: A new layer is created from peer (line 165-169)
```rust
if created_layer {
    if let Some(ref from_peer) = ctx.from_peer {
        emit_dynamic_layer_permits(state, &layer_name, from_peer).await;
    }
}
```

**What it does**:
1. Checks if layer matches a dynamic schema via `find_matching_dynamic_schema()` (line 473)
   - Must have 3+ segments: `prefix/did:key:.../id[/suffix]`
   - Creator DID extracted from second segment
   - Pattern matching against all schemas in our_permit.dynamic_layer_schemas

2. **Validates creator namespace** (line 477-485)
   - Sender's DID must match the DID in the layer path

3. **Collects connected peers** (line 495)
   - Reads from state.subscribers to get (did, role) pairs
   - Uses permit_holder_did from subscriber info

4. **Prepares layer permits** via `prepare_layer_permits()` (line 499-506)
   - Returns Vec<(recipient_did, permit_token)>

5. **Authorizes recipients** on LayerUnit (line 517-526)
   - Each recipient added to unit.authorized_dids for broadcast routing

6. **Emits SyncEvent::NewDynamicLayer** (line 529-538)
   - Channel: state.sync_event_tx
   - Coordinator receives this event

**Critical Gap #2**: The prepare_layer_permits function:
- For **role grants**: Issues permits only to peers whose role matches schema.role_permissions
- For **explicit grants**: Tries to get authority permit via issuer.get_layer_authority_permit()
  - If authority permit exists: uses it
  - If not: uses schema.permissions (fallback)

---

#### **4. `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/coordinator/mod.rs` - Permit Distribution**

**Entry Point**: `on_distribute_layer_permits()` (line 607-658)

**What it does**:
1. Stores each (recipient_did, permit_token) in butler.permits()
2. Finds PeerActor for each recipient
3. Sends LayerPermitMsg via PeerMessage::SendLayerPermit
4. **If peer not connected**: Stores permit for reconnect

**Critical Gap #3**: The PeerActor must be connected to send the permit immediately. If offline, it's stored but viewer won't know about the layer until reconnect.

---

#### **5. `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/peer_actor/consent.rs` - Layer Permit Reception**

**Entry Point**: `on_layer_permit()` (line 476-537)

**What it does**:
1. **Stores** layer permit in butler.permits()
2. **Authorizes** node on local Scribe (AuthorizeLayerSubscriber)
   ```rust
   subscription.scribe.cast(butler::ScribeMessage::AuthorizeLayerSubscriber {
       layer_name: bare_name.to_string(),
       subscriber_did: node_did.clone(),
   })
   ```
3. **Issues layer consent** back to node via `issue_layer_consent()` (line 545-600)
   - Uses gurkha::issue_sync_layer_consent()
   - Sends LayerConsentGrant message

**Critical Gap #4**: The authorization happens but the layer doesn't exist yet locally. The pending_layer_authorizations mechanism handles this:
- If layer exists: authorize immediately
- If layer doesn't exist: store in pending, apply when layer is created via create_layer_from_peer()

---

#### **6. `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/peer_actor/sync/protocol.rs` - Viewer's Sync-Meta Update**

**Entry Point**: `on_sync_offer()` when layer_name starts with `__sync_meta/` (line 388-392)

```rust
if Self::is_sync_meta_layer(page_id, layer_name) {
    self.request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta(page_id, layer_name, &scribe, state)
        .await;
}
```

**Function**: `request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta()` (line 167-252)

**What it does**:
1. Reads sync_meta layer data via GetLayerData (line 180-198)
2. **For each entry in sync_meta** (line 205-251):
   - If `synced: false` → layer is missing
   - Checks if layer exists locally via LayerExists (line 224-239)
   - **If missing**: Sends SyncReset message (line 246-250)

**Log line 245**: `"Requesting missing layer via SyncReset after sync-meta discovery"`

---

#### **7. `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/peer_actor/sync/protocol.rs` - Layer Snapshot Response**

**Entry Point**: `on_sync_reset()` (line 726-834)

**What it does**:
1. Gets full snapshot from Scribe via GetSnapshot (line 754-774)
2. Gets state vector via GetStateVector (line 776-796)
3. Encrypts snapshot
4. Sends SyncSnapshotMsg

**Return Path**: `on_sync_snapshot()` (line 841-953)
- Decrypts snapshot
- Calls ReplaceLayer to install full state
- Checks if sync_meta layer → triggers request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta() again (line 907-911)

---

### **IDENTIFIED GAPS IN THE FLOW**

#### **Gap #1: Authority Permit Not Piggybacked**

**Issue**: When owner creates a dynamic layer via `create_layer()`, the authority permit is issued in `issue_creator_layer_authority_permits()` but **is not automatically piggybacked on the first SyncOffer**.

**Location**: `/home/abe/osvauld/scribe/src/layer_unit/dynamic.rs:76-139`

**Current behavior**:
```rust
// Authority permits issued but NOT stored on layer for piggybacking
match issuer.issue_layer_authority_permit(...) {
    Ok((_token, _cid)) => { /* logged but token discarded */ }
    ...
}
```

**Expected behavior**: The token should be stored on the LayerUnit so it's piggybacked on the next SyncOffer from that layer.

**Fix needed**: 
- LayerUnit needs a field to store authority permit for piggybacking
- When emitting SyncOffer, check if layer has authority permit and include it

---

#### **Gap #2: Fanout Only Happens on Node**

**Issue**: `fanout_sync_meta_from_authority()` is only called when `state.mode == CourierMode::Node` (line 327-337).

**Location**: `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/peer_actor/sync/protocol.rs:327-337`

**Current behavior**:
```rust
if state.mode == crate::CourierMode::Node {
    self.fanout_sync_meta_from_authority(...).await;
}
```

**Problem**: If a viewer initiates a SyncOffer with an authority permit (shouldn't happen, but the code handles it), the fanout won't trigger.

**Likely not the issue** since viewers don't create layers, but inconsistent design.

---

#### **Gap #3: Role Determination in Fanout**

**Issue**: When fanning out sync_meta to role-based recipients, the code tries to match roles:

```rust
let role = parsed
    .get_fact("role")
    .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
    .or_else(|| parsed.get_fact("relationship").and_then(|v| v.as_str()));
```

**Problem**: The role/relationship must match a key in `schema.role_permissions`. But the error handling just logs a warning and skips the user (line 104-105):

```rust
warn!("No matching dynamic schema in authority permit for role fanout");
return;
```

**This is OK** — it's just skipping if schema doesn't exist. The real issue is if the role doesn't match.

---

#### **Gap #4: Missing Sync-Meta Entry on Viewer's Local Sync-Meta Layer**

**Issue**: When viewer receives a LayerPermitMsg from node, it:
1. Stores the permit
2. Authorizes the node on local Scribe
3. **BUT** does NOT add an entry to __sync_meta

**Current code** in `on_layer_permit()` (line 510-536): Only does storage and authorization, no sync_meta update.

**Expected behavior**: Viewer's __sync_meta should track that this layer needs to be synced. But sync_meta is managed by the node through fanout, not the viewer.

**Actually OK** — the viewer receives sync_meta updates from the node, so this isn't a gap.

---

#### **Gap #5: Timeout Waiting for Layer Data**

**Issue Description** (from your message):
> Timeout waiting for layer data on dynamic channels like `channels/did:key:.../messages`

**Root cause chain**:
1. Owner creates layer: `channels/{owner_did}/general/messages`
2. Owner's SyncOffer includes authority_permit (Gap #1: might not be piggybacked)
3. Node receives SyncOffer → calls fanout_sync_meta_from_authority()
4. Node writes to __sync_meta/{viewer_did}
5. Node broadcasts __sync_meta to viewer
6. Viewer receives __sync_meta update → calls request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta()
7. **Viewer checks LayerExists** but layer doesn't exist locally
8. **Viewer sends SyncReset**
9. **Node must respond with SyncSnapshot**

**The timeout suggests**: Either:
- **Step 5 fails**: Viewer never receives the __sync_meta update
- **Step 8 fails**: Viewer never sends SyncReset
- **Step 9 fails**: Node receives SyncReset but doesn't have the layer (or doesn't respond)

---

### **VERIFICATION CHECKLIST**

To debug why the timeout occurs, check:

1. **Authority permit piggybacking**:
   - Is the authority permit being stored in LayerUnit? (Gap #1)
   - Is it being included in SyncOffer messages?
   - **Log**: Search for "Issued creator layer authority permit" → verify the token is used

2. **Fanout to viewers**:
   - Does node call `fanout_sync_meta_from_authority()`?
   - **Log**: Search for "Requesting missing layer via SyncReset after sync-meta discovery"
   - Are the recipients list correctly populated from schema.role_permissions?

3. **Viewer receives sync-meta**:
   - Does viewer's on_sync_offer() detect __sync_meta layer?
   - **Log**: Look for "GetLayerData" calls on __sync_meta layers
   - Does sync_meta_json contain the dynamic layer entry?

4. **Missing layer detection**:
   - Does request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta() read entries correctly?
   - **Log**: "Requesting missing layer via SyncReset" should appear
   - Is LayerExists being called? What's the response?

5. **SyncReset handling**:
   - Does node receive the SyncReset?
   - **Log**: "SyncReset: page=... layer=... from ... - sending full snapshot"
   - Does node have the layer to snapshot? (GetSnapshot might return None)

6. **SyncSnapshot delivery**:
   - Does node send the SyncSnapshot?
   - **Log**: "Sent SyncSnapshot for page=... layer=..."
   - Does viewer receive it and apply it?

---

### **MOST LIKELY ROOT CAUSE**

Based on the code analysis, the **most likely issue** is:

**Authority permit is not being piggybacked on SyncOffer** (Gap #1)

**Why**:
1. `issue_creator_layer_authority_permits()` issues the permit but discards the token
2. The permit is never stored on the LayerUnit
3. When owner's Scribe broadcasts the layer via SyncOffer, no authority_permit is attached
4. Node's `on_sync_offer()` receives `authority_permit: None`
5. `fanout_sync_meta_from_authority()` is never called
6. No sync_meta entry is written for viewers
7. Viewer never receives sync_meta update

```
2. Owner writes data to layer

   └─> Checks if layer matches dynamic schema
   └─> Issues layer permits for connected peers
   └─> Emits SyncEvent::NewDynamicLayer

5. Coordinator receives SyncEvent::NewDynamicLayer
   └─> Stores layer permits in butler
   └─> Sends LayerPermitMsg to each viewer's PeerActor

6. Viewer's PeerActor receives LayerPermitMsg
   └─> Stores layer permit in butler
   └─> Calls AuthorizeLayerSubscriber to authorize node on local Scribe
   └─> Issues layer consent back to node

7. Viewer's Scribe broadcasts __sync_meta/{viewer_did} update to node

8. Viewer's PeerActor sends SyncReset to node

9. Viewer applies SyncSnapshot

```

---

### **DETAILED FILE-BY-FILE TRACE**

#### **1. `/home/abe/osvauld/scribe/src/layer_unit/dynamic.rs` - Layer Creation**

**Key State**: 
- Layer created with `is_dynamic = true` (line 54)

#### **2. `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/peer_actor/sync/protocol.rs` - Authority Fanout**

**Entry Point**: `on_sync_offer()` (line 262-439)

**Step 1: Authority Permit Piggybacking** (line 297-344)

```rust
    // Parse and store authority permit
    // If Node mode: fanout_sync_meta_from_authority()
```

**Critical Function**: `fanout_sync_meta_from_authority()` (line 77-164)
- Receives the authority permit from a SyncOffer
- **Determines recipients** (line 93-147):

#### **3. `/home/abe/osvauld/scribe/src/sync/apply.rs` - Dynamic Layer Detection**

**Entry Point**: `emit_dynamic_layer_permits()` (line 462-547)

**Triggered when**: A new layer is created from peer (line 165-169)

**What it does**:
1. Checks if layer matches a dynamic schema via `find_matching_dynamic_schema()` (line 473)

   - Creator DID extracted from second segment
   - Pattern matching against all schemas in our_permit.dynamic_layer_schemas

2. **Validates creator namespace** (line 477-485)

3. **Collects connected peers** (line 495)

4. **Prepares layer permits** via `prepare_layer_permits()` (line 499-506)

5. **Authorizes recipients** on LayerUnit (line 517-526)
   - Each recipient added to unit.authorized_dids for broadcast routing

6. **Emits SyncEvent::NewDynamicLayer** (line 529-538)
   - Channel: state.sync_event_tx

**Critical Gap #2**: The prepare_layer_permits function:
- For **role grants**: Issues permits only to peers whose role matches schema.role_permissions

#### **4. `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/coordinator/mod.rs` - Permit Distribution**

**Entry Point**: `on_distribute_layer_permits()` (line 607-658)

**What it does**:
1. Stores each (recipient_did, permit_token) in butler.permits()
2. Finds PeerActor for each recipient
3. Sends LayerPermitMsg via PeerMessage::SendLayerPermit
4. **If peer not connected**: Stores permit for reconnect

#### **5. `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/peer_actor/consent.rs` - Layer Permit Reception**

**Entry Point**: `on_layer_permit()` (line 476-537)

**What it does**:
1. **Stores** layer permit in butler.permits()

3. **Issues layer consent** back to node via `issue_layer_consent()` (line 545-600)

**Function**: `request_missing_layers_from_sync_meta()` (line 167-252)

**What it does**:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Custom Channel + DM Capture Test.

Runs two end-to-end cases in one scenario and captures events for each case:
1) Custom channel flow (owner + viewers)
2) DM flow (owner <-> viewer)

Usage:
    python e2e_tests/test_custom_channel.py
    python e2e_tests/test_custom_channel.py --keep
    python e2e_tests/test_custom_channel.py --capture-logs
"""

import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent.parent / "scripts"))

from osvauld.scenario import AppTestScenario

DEMOS_APP = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "sample_apps" / "osvauld-demos"

args = AppTestScenario.parse_args("Custom Channel Capture Test")

with AppTestScenario(
    name="custom_channel_test",
    app_path=str(DEMOS_APP),
    peers={
        "alice": {"role": "owner", "app": "Group Chat"},
        "bob": {"role": "viewer", "app": "Group Chat"},
        "carol": {"role": "viewer", "app": "Group Chat"},
    },
    **args,
) as s:
    alice = s.peer("alice")
    bob = s.peer("bob")
    carol = s.peer("carol")

    include_logs = "--capture-logs" in sys.argv

    def print_capture_summary(label, captures_dir, merged):
        if merged and merged.exists():
            line_count = sum(1 for _ in open(merged))
            print(f"  Captured {line_count} events -> {merged}")
            print("  Per-instance captures:")
            for name in ["node", "alice", "bob", "carol"]:
                f = captures_dir / f"{label}_{name}.jsonl"
                if f.exists():
                    n = sum(1 for _ in open(f))
                    print(f"    {name:8s}: {n} events")
            print("  Quick filters:")
            print(f"    grep 'sync_event' {merged}")
            print(f"    grep 'message_trace' {merged}")
            print(f"    grep 'page_update' {merged}")
            print(f"    grep 'LayerChanged' {merged}")
            print(f"    grep 'NewDynamicLayer' {merged}")
            print(f"    grep 'LayerAccessChanged' {merged}")
        else:
            print("  Warning: No capture data collected")

    print("\n=== CASE 1: Custom channel flow ===")

    # Start capture for custom channel flow
    print("[1/5] Starting channel event capture...")
    captures_dir = s.capture_start("custom_channel", include_logs=include_logs)
    print(f"  Capturing to {captures_dir}/")

    # Alice creates a custom channel (dynamic layer)
    print("[2/5] Alice creates custom channel 'project-x'...")
    alice.eval('create_channel("project-x")')
    time.sleep(2)

    # Alice sends a message in the new channel (create_channel auto-switches)
    print("[3/5] Alice sends message in 'project-x'...")
    alice.eval('send_message("Owner message in project-x")')
    time.sleep(2)

    # Bob switches to project-x and tries to send
    print("[4/5] Bob switches to 'project-x' and sends message...")
    bob.eval('switch_channel("project-x")')
    time.sleep(1)
    try:
        bob.eval('send_message("Bob message in project-x")')
        print("  Bob send_message returned OK")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Bob send_message error: {e}")

    # Carol switches and tries to send
    print("  Carol switches to 'project-x' and sends message...")
    carol.eval('switch_channel("project-x")')
    time.sleep(1)
    try:
        carol.eval('send_message("Carol message in project-x")')
        print("  Carol send_message returned OK")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Carol send_message error: {e}")

    # Wait for sync
    print("[5/5] Waiting 2s for sync...")
    time.sleep(2)

    # Check what each peer sees
    alice_count = alice.eval("return get_message_count()")
    bob_count = bob.eval("return get_message_count()")
    carol_count = carol.eval("return get_message_count()")
    print(f"\n  Message counts in project-x:")
    print(f"    Alice (owner):  {alice_count}")
    print(f"    Bob (viewer):   {bob_count}")
    print(f"    Carol (viewer): {carol_count}")

    # Stop channel capture and dump
    print("\n  Stopping channel capture and merging...")
    merged = s.capture_end("custom_channel", merge=True)
    print_capture_summary("custom_channel", captures_dir, merged)

    print("\n=== CASE 2: DM flow ===")

    alice_did = alice.eval("return permit:my_did()")
    bob_did = bob.eval("return permit:my_did()")

    print("[1/5] Starting DM event capture...")
    captures_dir_dm = s.capture_start("dm_flow", include_logs=include_logs)
    print(f"  Capturing to {captures_dir_dm}/")

    print("[2/5] Alice creates DM with Bob...")
    alice.eval(f'create_dm("{bob_did}", "bob")')
    time.sleep(2)

    print("[3/5] Alice sends DM message...")
    alice.eval('send_dm_message("Hello Bob (DM)")')
    time.sleep(2)

    print("[4/5] Bob opens Alice's DM and replies...")
    opened = False
    for _ in range(10):
        opened = bool(bob.eval(f'return open_dm("{alice_did}", "alice")'))
        if opened:
            break
        time.sleep(0.5)
    print(f"  Bob open_dm: {'OK' if opened else 'NOT FOUND'}")
    time.sleep(1)
    bob.eval('send_dm_message("Hello Alice (DM reply)")')
    time.sleep(2)

    print("[5/5] Collecting DM counts...")
    alice_dm_count = alice.eval("return get_dm_message_count()")
    bob_dm_count = bob.eval("return get_dm_message_count()")
    carol_dm_count = carol.eval("return get_dm_message_count()")
    print("  DM message counts:")
    print(f"    Alice (owner):  {alice_dm_count}")
    print(f"    Bob (viewer):   {bob_dm_count}")
    print(f"    Carol (viewer): {carol_dm_count}")

    print("\n  Stopping DM capture and merging...")
    merged_dm = s.capture_end("dm_flow", merge=True)
    print_capture_summary("dm_flow", captures_dir_dm, merged_dm)

    print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
    if alice_count >= 1 and bob_count >= 1 and carol_count >= 1:
        print("  [CHANNEL OK] Custom channel messages synced")
    else:
        print("  [CHANNEL ISSUE] Custom channel sync is incomplete")

    if alice_dm_count >= 2 and bob_dm_count >= 2:
        print("  [DM OK] DM messages synced between Alice and Bob")
    else:
        print("  [DM ISSUE] DM sync is incomplete")

    if carol_dm_count == 0:
        print("  [DM OK] Carol has no active DM messages")
    else:
        print("  [DM NOTE] Carol has DM messages; inspect captures for why")

    print("  Captures available for both cases:")
    print("    - custom_channel_*.jsonl + custom_channel_merged.jsonl")
    print("    - dm_flow_*.jsonl + dm_flow_merged.jsonl")
    print(f"{'=' * 60}")

-- Channels — switch, create, ensure defaults
-- Default channels (general/random/dev) are static layers in the permit template.
-- Custom user-created channels use create_layer() for DID-namespaced dynamic layers.

local M = {}

-- Module state (set by init)
local page_id = nil
local my_did = nil
local my_name = nil
local channels_meta_layer = nil
local active_channel = "general"

-- Current channel's messages layer (LoroMap)
local messages_layer = nil

-- Current channel's bare layer path (for binding/rebinding)
local active_layer_path = nil

-- Callback to refresh messages when channel changes
local on_channel_switch = nil

-- Read tracker module reference (set by init)
local read_tracker = nil

-- Default channels — these are static layers in the permit template
local DEFAULT_CHANNELS = {
    { id = "general", name = "general", topic = "General discussion" },
    { id = "random", name = "random", topic = "Random stuff" },
    { id = "dev", name = "dev", topic = "Development talk" },
}

-- Check if a channel ID is a default (static) channel
local function is_default_channel(channel_id)
    for _, ch in ipairs(DEFAULT_CHANNELS) do
        if ch.id == channel_id then return true end
    end
    return false
end

-- Get the layer path for a channel.
-- Default channels: simple static path (e.g., "channels/general/messages")
-- Custom channels: DID-namespaced path stored in channels_meta
local function get_channel_layer_path(channel_id)
    if is_default_channel(channel_id) then
        return "channels/" .. channel_id .. "/messages"
    end
    -- Custom channel: read DID-namespaced path from meta
    local ch_meta = channels_meta_layer and channels_meta_layer:get(channel_id)
    if ch_meta and ch_meta.layer_path then
        return ch_meta.layer_path
    end
    -- Fallback for channels without stored path
    return "channels/" .. channel_id .. "/messages"
end

function M.init(pid, did, name, callback, tracker)
    page_id = pid
    my_did = did
    my_name = name
    on_channel_switch = callback
    read_tracker = tracker

    channels_meta_layer = scribe:map(page_id .. "/channels_meta")

    M.ensure_default_channels()
    M.switch_channel("general")
end

function M.ensure_default_channels()
    if not channels_meta_layer then return end

    for _, ch in ipairs(DEFAULT_CHANNELS) do
        local existing = channels_meta_layer:get(ch.id)
        if not existing then
            -- Default channels use simple static paths (no create_layer needed)
            channels_meta_layer:set(ch.id, {
                id = ch.id,
                name = ch.name,
                topic = ch.topic,
                created_by = my_did,
                created_at = os.time(),
            })
        end
    end

    M.refresh_channel_list()
end

function M.refresh_channel_list()
    if not channels_meta_layer then return end

    local channel_list = {}
    local keys = channels_meta_layer:keys()
    if keys then
        for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
            local ch = channels_meta_layer:get(key)
            if ch then
                local ch_id = ch.id or key
                local unread = 0
                local has_mention = false
                if read_tracker then
                    local ch_layer_path = get_channel_layer_path(ch_id)
                    local ch_msgs_layer = scribe:map(page_id .. "/" .. ch_layer_path)
                    unread, has_mention = read_tracker.count_unread(ch_id, ch_msgs_layer)
                end
                local is_active = ch_id == active_channel
                table.insert(channel_list, {
                    id = ch_id,
                    name = ch.name or key,
                    topic = ch.topic or "",
                    unread = is_active and 0 or unread,
                    is_active = is_active,
                    has_mention = is_active and false or has_mention,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    -- Sort alphabetically, but keep "general" first
    table.sort(channel_list, function(a, b)
        if a.id == "general" then return true end
        if b.id == "general" then return false end
        return a.name < b.name
    end)

    ui:set("channels", channel_list)
end

function M.switch_channel(channel_id)
    active_channel = channel_id

    local layer_path = get_channel_layer_path(channel_id)
    active_layer_path = layer_path

    -- Get messages layer using the full path
    messages_layer = scribe:map(page_id .. "/" .. layer_path)

    -- Mark as read immediately on switch
    if read_tracker then
        read_tracker.mark_read(channel_id, messages_layer)
    end

    -- Update UI
    local ch_meta = channels_meta_layer and channels_meta_layer:get(channel_id)
    ui:set("active_channel", channel_id)
    ui:set("active_channel_topic", ch_meta and ch_meta.topic or "")

    -- Refresh channel list (to update active state)
    M.refresh_channel_list()

    -- Notify parent with layer_path (for binding/rebinding)
    if on_channel_switch then
        on_channel_switch(channel_id, layer_path)
    end
end

function M.create_channel(name)
    if not name or name == "" then return end
    if not channels_meta_layer then return end

    -- Sanitize: lowercase, replace spaces with hyphens
    local id = name:lower():gsub("%s+", "-"):gsub("[^%w%-]", "")
    if id == "" then return end

    -- Check if already exists
    local existing = channels_meta_layer:get(id)
    if existing then
        M.switch_channel(id)
        return
    end

    -- Custom channels use create_layer() for DID-namespaced dynamic path
    local result = scribe:create_layer("channels/{id}/messages", id)
    local layer_path = nil
    if result and result.layer_name then
        -- Strip page_id/ prefix to get bare path
        local prefix = page_id .. "/"
        if result.layer_name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
            layer_path = result.layer_name:sub(#prefix + 1)
        else
            layer_path = result.layer_name
        end
    end

    channels_meta_layer:set(id, {
        id = id,
        name = id,
        topic = "",
        created_by = my_did,
        created_at = os.time(),
        layer_path = layer_path,
    })

    M.refresh_channel_list()
    M.switch_channel(id)
end

function M.get_active_channel()
    return active_channel
end

function M.get_active_layer_path()
    return active_layer_path
end

function M.get_messages_layer()
    return messages_layer
end

function M.get_channels_meta_layer()
    return channels_meta_layer
end

return M

-- DMs & Private Channels — explicit dynamic layers with named collaborators
-- 1:1 DMs: sorted-DID stable id, 2 participants
-- Private channels: named, N participants, same explicit grant mechanism

local M = {}

-- Module state (set by init)
local page_id = nil
local my_did = nil
local my_name = nil
local active_dm = nil
local dm_entries = {}

-- Current DM's messages layer (LoroMap)
local messages_layer = nil

-- Current DM's bare layer path (for binding/rebinding)
local active_layer_path = nil

-- Callback to refresh messages when DM changes
local on_dm_switch = nil

-- Generate a stable DM id from two DIDs (sorted, last 8 chars each)
local function make_dm_id(did_a, did_b)
    local a, b = did_a, did_b
    if a > b then a, b = b, a end
    return "dm-" .. a:sub(-8) .. "-" .. b:sub(-8)
end

local function dm_owner_did(did_a, did_b)
    if did_a < did_b then
        return did_a
    end
    return did_b
end

-- Sanitize a name for use as layer id
local function sanitize_id(name)
    return name:lower():gsub("%s+", "-"):gsub("[^%w%-]", "")
end

function M.init(pid, did, name, callback)
    page_id = pid
    my_did = did
    my_name = name
    on_dm_switch = callback

    dm_entries = {}
    M.refresh_dm_list()
end

local function normalize_layer_path(layer_name)
    if not layer_name then return nil end

    local prefix = page_id .. "/"
    if layer_name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
        return layer_name:sub(#prefix + 1)
    end

    return layer_name
end

local function split_first_two(path)
    local first, second = path:match("^([^/]+)/([^/]+)")
    return first, second
end

local function is_my_layer(layer_path)
    if not layer_path then return false end
    local _prefix, creator_did = split_first_two(layer_path)
    return creator_did == my_did
end

local function find_existing_dm_layer_path(dm_id)
    local suffix = "/" .. dm_id .. "/messages"
    local matches = scribe:list_layers("*" .. suffix)
    if not matches or #matches == 0 then
        return nil
    end

    table.sort(matches)
    return matches[1]
end

local function grant_participants(layer_path, participants)
    if not layer_path or not participants then return end

    local full_layer_name = page_id .. "/" .. layer_path
    for _, did in ipairs(participants) do
        if did ~= my_did then
            pcall(function()
                scribe:add_layer_access(full_layer_name, did)
            end)
        end
    end
end

function M.create_dm(other_did, other_name)
    if other_did == my_did then return end

    local dm_id = make_dm_id(my_did, other_did)

    -- Check if already exists
    local existing = dm_entries[dm_id]
    if existing then
        M.switch_dm(dm_id)
        return
    end

    -- Reuse an existing participant layer if already visible, otherwise create.
    local layer_path = find_existing_dm_layer_path(dm_id)
    if not layer_path then
        -- Canonical owner creates the DM layer; other participant waits to discover it.
        local owner_did = dm_owner_did(my_did, other_did)
        if my_did ~= owner_did then
            return false
        end

        local result = scribe:create_layer("dms/{id}/messages", dm_id)
        layer_path = normalize_layer_path(result and result.layer_name)
    end

    dm_entries[dm_id] = {
        id = dm_id,
        is_group = false,
        participants = { my_did, other_did },
        participant_names = { [my_did] = my_name, [other_did] = other_name },
        created_by = my_did,
        created_at = os.time(),
        layer_path = layer_path,
    }

    if is_my_layer(layer_path) then
        grant_participants(layer_path, { my_did, other_did })
    end

    M.refresh_dm_list()
    M.switch_dm(dm_id)
    return true
end

function M.open_dm(other_did, other_name)
    if other_did == my_did then return false end

    local dm_id = make_dm_id(my_did, other_did)
    local existing = dm_entries[dm_id]
    if existing then
        M.switch_dm(dm_id)
        return true
    end

    local layer_path = find_existing_dm_layer_path(dm_id)
    if not layer_path then
        return false
    end

    dm_entries[dm_id] = {
        id = dm_id,
        is_group = false,
        participants = { my_did, other_did },
        participant_names = { [my_did] = my_name, [other_did] = other_name },
        created_by = dm_owner_did(my_did, other_did),
        created_at = os.time(),
        layer_path = layer_path,
    }

    M.refresh_dm_list()
    M.switch_dm(dm_id)
    return true
end

function M.create_private_channel(name, members)
    if not name or name == "" then return end
    if not members or #members == 0 then return end

    local id = sanitize_id(name)
    if id == "" then return end

    -- Check if already exists
    local existing = dm_entries[id]
    if existing then
        M.switch_dm(id)
        return
    end

    -- Build participant lists (always include self)
    local participants = { my_did }
    local participant_names = { [my_did] = my_name }
    for _, member in ipairs(members) do
        if member.did ~= my_did then
            table.insert(participants, member.did)
            participant_names[member.did] = member.name
        end
    end

    -- Reuse an existing participant layer if already visible, otherwise create.
    local layer_path = find_existing_dm_layer_path(id)
    if not layer_path then
        local result = scribe:create_layer("dms/{id}/messages", id)
        layer_path = normalize_layer_path(result and result.layer_name)
    end

    dm_entries[id] = {
        id = id,
        name = name,
        is_group = true,
        participants = participants,
        participant_names = participant_names,
        created_by = my_did,
        created_at = os.time(),
        layer_path = layer_path,
    }

    if is_my_layer(layer_path) then
        grant_participants(layer_path, participants)
    end

    M.refresh_dm_list()
    M.switch_dm(id)
end

function M.switch_dm(dm_id)
    local meta = dm_entries[dm_id]
    if not meta then return end

    active_dm = dm_id

    local layer_path = meta.layer_path
    if not layer_path then return end

                    display_name = name
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if not display_name then display_name = dm_id end
    end

    ui:set("active_dm", dm_id)
    ui:set("active_dm_name", display_name)

    M.refresh_dm_list()

    if on_dm_switch then
        on_dm_switch(dm_id, layer_path)
    end
end

function M.refresh_dm_list()
    local dm_list = {}
    for key, meta in pairs(dm_entries) do
        if meta and meta.participants then
            -- Only show DMs where I'm a participant
            local am_participant = false
            for _, did in ipairs(meta.participants) do
                if did == my_did then
                    am_participant = true
                    break
                end
            end

            if am_participant then
                -- Determine display name
                local display_name = meta.name
                if not display_name or display_name == "" then
                    -- 1:1 DM: show other person's name
                    if meta.participant_names then
                        for did, name in pairs(meta.participant_names) do
                            if did ~= my_did then
                                display_name = name
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if not display_name then display_name = meta.id or key end
                end

                table.insert(dm_list, {
                    id = meta.id or key,
                    name = display_name,
                    is_active = (meta.id or key) == active_dm,
                    is_group = meta.is_group or false,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    -- Sort: most recent first
    table.sort(dm_list, function(a, b)
        return a.name < b.name
    end)

    ui:set("dms", dm_list)
end

function M.get_active_dm()
    return active_dm
end

function M.get_active_layer_path()
    return active_layer_path
end

function M.get_messages_layer()
    return messages_layer
end

return M

-- Channels — switch, create, ensure defaults
-- Default channels (general/random/dev) are static layers in the permit template.
-- Custom user-created channels use create_layer() for DID-namespaced dynamic layers.

local M = {}

-- Module state (set by init)
local page_id = nil
local my_did = nil
local my_name = nil
local channels_meta_layer = nil
local active_channel = "general"

-- Current channel's messages layer (LoroMap)
local messages_layer = nil

-- Current channel's bare layer path (for binding/rebinding)
local active_layer_path = nil

-- Callback to refresh messages when channel changes
local on_channel_switch = nil

-- Read tracker module reference (set by init)
local read_tracker = nil

-- Default channels — these are static layers in the permit template
local DEFAULT_CHANNELS = {
    { id = "general", name = "general", topic = "General discussion" },
    { id = "random", name = "random", topic = "Random stuff" },
    { id = "dev", name = "dev", topic = "Development talk" },
}

-- Check if a channel ID is a default (static) channel
local function is_default_channel(channel_id)
    for _, ch in ipairs(DEFAULT_CHANNELS) do
        if ch.id == channel_id then return true end
    end
    return false
end

-- Get the layer path for a channel.
-- Default channels: simple static path (e.g., "channels/general/messages")
-- Custom channels: DID-namespaced path stored in channels_meta
local function get_channel_layer_path(channel_id)
    if is_default_channel(channel_id) then
        return "channels/" .. channel_id .. "/messages"
    end
    -- Custom channel: read DID-namespaced path from meta
    local ch_meta = channels_meta_layer and channels_meta_layer:get(channel_id)
    if ch_meta and ch_meta.layer_path then
        return ch_meta.layer_path
    end
    -- Fallback for channels without stored path
    return "channels/" .. channel_id .. "/messages"
end

function M.init(pid, did, name, callback, tracker)
    page_id = pid
    my_did = did
    my_name = name
    on_channel_switch = callback
    read_tracker = tracker

    channels_meta_layer = scribe:map(page_id .. "/channels_meta")

    M.ensure_default_channels()
    M.switch_channel("general")
end

function M.ensure_default_channels()
    if not channels_meta_layer then return end

    for _, ch in ipairs(DEFAULT_CHANNELS) do
        local existing = channels_meta_layer:get(ch.id)
        if not existing then
            -- Default channels use simple static paths (no create_layer needed)
            channels_meta_layer:set(ch.id, {
                id = ch.id,
                name = ch.name,
                topic = ch.topic,
                created_by = my_did,
                created_at = os.time(),
            })
        end
    end

    M.refresh_channel_list()
end

function M.refresh_channel_list()
    if not channels_meta_layer then return end

    local channel_list = {}
    local keys = channels_meta_layer:keys()
    if keys then
        for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
            local ch = channels_meta_layer:get(key)
            if ch then
                local ch_id = ch.id or key
                local unread = 0
                local has_mention = false
                if read_tracker then
                    local ch_layer_path = get_channel_layer_path(ch_id)
                    local ch_msgs_layer = scribe:map(page_id .. "/" .. ch_layer_path)
                    unread, has_mention = read_tracker.count_unread(ch_id, ch_msgs_layer)
                end
                local is_active = ch_id == active_channel
                table.insert(channel_list, {
                    id = ch_id,
                    name = ch.name or key,
                    topic = ch.topic or "",
                    unread = is_active and 0 or unread,
                    is_active = is_active,
                    has_mention = is_active and false or has_mention,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    -- Sort alphabetically, but keep "general" first
    table.sort(channel_list, function(a, b)
        if a.id == "general" then return true end
        if b.id == "general" then return false end
        return a.name < b.name
    end)

    ui:set("channels", channel_list)
end

function M.switch_channel(channel_id)
    active_channel = channel_id

    local layer_path = get_channel_layer_path(channel_id)
    active_layer_path = layer_path

    -- Get messages layer using the full path
    messages_layer = scribe:map(page_id .. "/" .. layer_path)

    -- Mark as read immediately on switch
    if read_tracker then
        read_tracker.mark_read(channel_id, messages_layer)
    end

    -- Update UI
    local ch_meta = channels_meta_layer and channels_meta_layer:get(channel_id)
    ui:set("active_channel", channel_id)
    ui:set("active_channel_topic", ch_meta and ch_meta.topic or "")

    -- Refresh channel list (to update active state)
    M.refresh_channel_list()

    -- Notify parent with layer_path (for binding/rebinding)
    if on_channel_switch then
        on_channel_switch(channel_id, layer_path)
    end
end

function M.create_channel(name)
    if not name or name == "" then return end
    if not channels_meta_layer then return end

    -- Sanitize: lowercase, replace spaces with hyphens
    local id = name:lower():gsub("%s+", "-"):gsub("[^%w%-]", "")
    if id == "" then return end

    -- Check if already exists
    local existing = channels_meta_layer:get(id)
    if existing then
        M.switch_channel(id)
        return
    end

    -- Custom channels use create_layer() for DID-namespaced dynamic path
    local result = scribe:create_layer("channels/{id}/messages", id)
    local layer_path = nil
    if result and result.layer_name then
        -- Strip page_id/ prefix to get bare path
        local prefix = page_id .. "/"
        if result.layer_name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
            layer_path = result.layer_name:sub(#prefix + 1)
        else
            layer_path = result.layer_name
        end
    end

    channels_meta_layer:set(id, {
        id = id,
        name = id,
        topic = "",
        created_by = my_did,
        created_at = os.time(),
        layer_path = layer_path,
    })

    M.refresh_channel_list()
    M.switch_channel(id)
end

function M.get_active_channel()
    return active_channel
end

function M.get_active_layer_path()
    return active_layer_path
end

function M.get_messages_layer()
    return messages_layer
end

function M.get_channels_meta_layer()
    return channels_meta_layer
end

return M

    25→    local a, b = did_a, did_b

    31→    if did_a < did_b then

    52→local function normalize_layer_path(layer_name)

    57→        return layer_name:sub(#prefix + 1)

    60→    return layer_name
    61→end

    63→local function split_first_two(path)
    64→    local first, second = path:match("^([^/]+)/([^/]+)")

    68→local function is_my_layer(layer_path)

    74→local function find_existing_dm_layer_path(dm_id)
    75→    local suffix = "/" .. dm_id .. "/messages"

    78→        return nil

    81→    table.sort(matches)

    85→local function grant_participants(layer_path, participants)

    98→function M.create_dm(other_did, other_name)
